faq_heading: Homes near Hellings Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Hellings Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Hellings Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Hellings Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Hellings Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 70 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,192,000, townhomes $737,500, condos $445,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Hellings Elementary?
faq.a: Near Hellings Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 26 days to sell and closed at 96.1% of the list price, with 6% over asking, across 70 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Hellings Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Immaculate Conception School (0.7 km north-east), Gibson Elementary (0.8 km north-west) and Delta Continuing Education (0.8 km south).

Hellings Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 11655 86 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Hellings Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Hellings Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Hellings Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Hellings Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 70 homes sold within 1 km of Hellings Elementary: 39 houses, 6 townhomes and 19 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,192,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Hellings Elementary

27 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Hellings Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Immaculate Conception School, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Sikh Academy, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Delta Continuing Education (0.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Richardson Elementary (0.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Immaculate Conception School (0.7 km north-east), Gibson Elementary (0.8 km north-west), Richardson Elementary (0.9 km south-west), Devon Gardens Elementary (1.1 km north-west), McCloskey Elementary (1.3 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Immaculate Conception School, 0.7 km north-east of Hellings Elementary.
